meta.name: apex
meta.description: Engineering lead — hand Apex any task and it routes internally. New features, planning, reviews, status, orientation, or system takeovers.

copy.tagline: 自动把工程任务分派给团队内最合适的人
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你们团队需要自动路由工程任务,减少人工协调
copy.tagline_en: Automatically route engineering tasks to the right team member
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team needs automatic task routing to reduce manual coordination

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会变成工程负责人。它会接收你的工程任务，自动选择并调用合适的专业技能（如规划、代码审查等），并负责从头到尾交付结果。
howto.when: 当你提出新功能规划、代码审查、项目状态查询、代码库熟悉或系统接管等工程相关请求时触发。如果没有明确指定，默认执行项目状态查询。

say.text: 帮我规划一个新功能，给出S/M/L三种方案和成本估算。
审查最近完成的代码变更，准备发布。
这个代码库的整体情况如何？有什么正在进行的工作？

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude becomes an engineering lead. It receives your engineering task and internally routes to the right specialist skill (e.g., planning, code review), owning the outcome end-to-end.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for new feature planning, code review, project status, codebase orientation, or system takeover. Defaults to project status if unclear.

say_en.text: Plan a new feature and give S/M/L options with cost estimates.
Review recent code changes for launch readiness.
What's the status of the codebase? What's in progress?
